method: Free public sitemap discovery and full-page retrieval. Candidates mention a current official and AI before the related-story section. These are source leads, not accepted evidence. Full direct quote, author, date, role and duplicate checks still apply. Non-government sources retain the existing 25-word aggregate quotation limit; the extractor now asks for self-contained short quotations rather than proposing longer text that the writer must reject. Full source context remains available to Astra.
